description: Resize an image by pixels or percent, keeping the aspect ratio. Give width or height (the other side follows), or both: fit "cover" (default, as on the website) centre-crops to that ratio first so nothing is stretched, "contain" fits inside the box, "fill" stretches. Optional crop ratio (1:1, 4:5, 3:2, 16:9, 9:16, orig) or crop box before resizing, social-media presets, output JPEG/PNG/WebP/AVIF. Up to 16384 px a side. Output name: <name>-<W>x<H>.<ext>. Web version: https://s3eidat.github.io/image-resize/

crop.description: Crop box (x, y, width, height in pixels) applied before resizing; overrides ratio.

fit.description: When both width and height are set: cover (crop to fill, default), contain (fit inside), fill (stretch).

format.description: Output format. "keep" = same as the input when it is JPEG/PNG/WebP (else PNG). Default keep.

image.description: The image: a local file path (absolute, or relative to the server's --root) or base64 data (raw or a data: URI).

output.description: Where to write the result: a file path, or a folder ending in "/". Default: the server output folder (a temp folder unless --out-dir is set).

percent.description: Scale by percent instead (e.g. 50 halves both sides, 200 doubles).

preset.description: Exact output size preset: instagram-post 1080×1080, instagram-portrait 1080×1350, story 1080×1920, youtube-thumbnail 1280×720, x-header 1500×500, facebook-cover 851×315, linkedin-banner 1584×396, full-hd 1920×1080, passport-35x45 413×531, us-passport-2x2 600×600.

quality.description: Quality 1-100 for JPEG / WebP / AVIF (ignored for PNG). Default 90, same as the website.

ratio.description: Aspect ratio as "W:H" (e.g. "1:1", "4:5", "3:2", "16:9", "9:16"), a number (width/height), "orig" or "free".

returnBase64.description: Also return the output as base64 in the result (only for small files). Default false.

name: image_resize
title: Resize image
